description: Code quality lint rules for Kotlin — enforces val preference, null safety, and structured logging

rules.description: No println() in production Kotlin — use SLF4J or Kotlin logging
rules.message: Replace println() with a structured logger: logger.info("{}", value)

rules.description: Avoid !! (not-null assertion) — prefer safe calls or let
rules.message: !! throws NullPointerException — use ?. safe call, ?: elvis, or let { } instead

rules.description: Prefer val over var for immutable values
rules.message: Consider using val if this variable is never reassigned
